title: Ocean Fresh Slovakian Fish Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful pescatarian-friendly stew featuring fermented ingredients and soya milk, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This traditional Slovakian dish is made with a variety of fish and vegetables.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the carrots and potatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the cod fillets and cook until they are opaque and flake easily with a fork.
Add the fermented sauerkraut, soya milk, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes.
Use a whisk to stir the stew and break up any large pieces of fish.
Reduce the heat to low and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
